summary: WF International Limited, a Chengdu-based construction special trade contractor listed on Nasdaq under WXM, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering the sale of 111,333 ordinary shares at $1.50 per share, an aggregate offering amount of $166,999.50, to certain investors under a share purchase agreement dated August 19, 2026. The pricing represents a discount to the August 19 closing price of $4.50. The filing is a routine at-the-market-style takedown under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, not a special situation. The company plans a CSRC filing within three business days after closing per PRC Trial Measures. Watch for dilution and any acceleration of the shelf program.
